positions.as_written: Start at the fibular head and follow the cord proximally to the femoral epicondyle.
Assess the common peroneal nerve at the same sitting, since it is adjacent.
An isolated injury is uncommon, so finding one should prompt a search for the rest of the corner.
- An isolated injury is uncommon and should prompt a wider search.
The adjacent nerve should be assessed whenever a lateral injury is found.
